acceptance: Editorial PRs still get a downloadable preview artifact
Non-editorial PRs skip the upload or it no longer gates merge
context: Found by two independent adversarial reviewers (Muse Spark 1.3 review of PR #46; GPT-6 Astra review of the same diff) during the Oct 19 blog-workflow session. PR #46's artifact measured 115,039,640 bytes with 7-day retention.
description: The site-preview artifact upload added in PR #46 (.github/workflows/ci.yml, inside the required checks job, PR-event only) runs on every pull request regardless of whether it touches publishable content, and an artifact-service failure fails the required ci gate. Gate the upload on publication-relevant paths or move it out of the required job.
